records.failureSummary: Slice-3 (create + list/search) integration verification and regression re-run completed against the implemented code. (1) Slice-scoped run: node --test over test/ac14-create-task.test.js, ac15-title-length-boundary.test.js, ac16-title-trim-blank.test.js, ac17-title-unicode-emoji.test.js, ac18-due-date-validation.test.js, ac23-list-search-isolation.test.js => 35 tests, 35 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors (AC-14 x3, AC-15 x7, AC-16 x4, AC-17 x5, AC-18 x7, AC-23 x9); all names containing their AC tag are green. (2) Full regression: pnpm test => 67 tests, 67 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors (adds AC-01..AC-13, AC-04 persistence and AC-30 project contract). (3) Temporary DATA_DIR: every slice test file calls fs.mkdtempSync under os.tmpdir(), sets process.env.DATA_DIR plus a fixed TOKEN_SECRET before requiring src/server.js, listens on port 0 on 127.0.0.1 and closes the server and removes the temp dir in after(); so the real service runs against a throwaway data dir. (4) Create plus list/search smoke is exercised by those same real-server suites: register 201 -> login 200 -> POST /api/tasks 201 -> GET /api/tasks 200, asserting the fixed six-field task object (id UUID, title, dueDate, done, createdAt, updatedAt) with ISO 8601 createdAt/updatedAt, case-insensitive q substring filtering over title only, owner-only listing (user B never sees user A tasks, and vice versa), and hostile q (quotes, semicolons, SQL fragments, control characters, malformed percent-encoding) returning 200 or a canonical 4xx and never 5xx. No product code was modified by this task (zero edits, zero new files). No test failure was observed, so no fix is required: fixTaskType NONE. Only caveat recorded: the enforce check for this TEST task compares against expected=fail, so a fully green suite trips the VACUOUS_TEST label; that is a harness expectation mismatch, not a product or test defect.
